senses.gloss: return, going back, opp. הֲלִיכָה. Y. B. Mets. VI, beg. 10ᵈ שכר הליכה וח׳ indemnification for loss of time in going to the field and returning.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:4">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>בחֲזִירַת רבותינו לשם</he> when the teachers came again to that place, v. <cite ref="E00109"><he>הֲדוּרָה</he></cite>.—Y. Yoma III, 43ᶜ bot. <he>דרך ח׳</he> on the way homeward.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> … <he>מעט בריצה בח׳</he> slacken thy speed, that thou mayest not have too far to return (regret and punishment will reach you); a. fr.

senses.gloss: reconsideration, reversion of judgment. Y. Hor. I, beg. 45ᵈ bot. וכן בח׳ the same rule applies when the court reverses &c.

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2:7">Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כדי חֲזִירַת דקל</he> (Bab.
<cite ref="Sotah 4a:12">ib. 4ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="H00572"><he>חֲזָרַת</he></cite>) the time required for going round a palm-tree.
